goal: Persist incremental page-ready reports and event checkpoints to accelerate dashboard pages and service restarts.
constraints: Preserve original event history, existing settings, secrets and all prior uncommitted changes.
Use atomic checkpoint/report updates and indexed source positions.
Keep UI filtering, fixtures, timezone and late event semantics correct.

non_goals.description: Do not modify EconoRoute application code or credentials.

acceptance.criterion: Report reducer equivalence, idempotency, restart and late event regressions pass
Warm page and restart timings improve on actual existing history; browser behavior and existing history are preserved; difit review opened.
